feeds.title: Shutterbug
feeds.description: Company Overview - Shutterbug provides the serious photographer a unique combination of inspiring feature stories, the latest test reports, and pro topics in every issue. Inside every monthly issue you'll get lighting pointers, pro studio tips, test reports, business trends, and much more! Shutterbug is dedicated to helping photographers enhance their creative potential.

feeds.title: 35mmc
feeds.description: Reviews, thoughts & experiences with 35mm compact cameras, rangefinders & lenses. From vintage manual focus cameras to auto focus point and shoots and everything in between.

feeds.title: Film Advance
feeds.description: Gary Seronik is an avid photographer living in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. He began taking pictures in 1980 when he received his first camera (a well used Zeiss Ikon Continamatic) from a favourite uncle.

feeds.title: Analogue Wonderland Blog
feeds.description: Analogue Wonderland's blog - with regular updates about film stocks, new products and store news. Subscribe to get updates sent directly to your feed!

feeds.title: Random Camera Blog
feeds.description: have been photographing since I was about 12 years old. My first camera was a Kodak 126 Instamatic and I still have all the negatives from those early days. I really enjoy shooting with older manual film-based equipment. For me, photography is an ongoing journey. I don't know where I will end up, but I am always changing routes and finding my way around.

feeds.title: Japan Camera Hunter
feeds.description: Welcome to JCH, where you can hopefully find your perfect film camera or lens. My name is Bellamy, and I love exploring the city, taking pictures and sharing my photographic knowledge with people.

feeds.title: Dora Goodman Blog
feeds.description: A film photography blog written by a copywriter, Jess Hobbs, a film photographer based out of Montreal, Canada. Through this blog, she shares her personal experiences using the wide range of Goodman cameras and accessories and helps you all on your own journey.

feeds.title: Fstoppers » Film Photography
feeds.description: This section features articles on Film Photography. Fstoppers is an online community aimed at educating and inspiring photographers, videographers, and creative professionals. Started in 2010 by founders Patrick Hall and Lee Morris, Fstoppers has grown into one of the top resources for photography lighting, gear reviews, business tips, behind the scenes, and industry news.

feeds.title: Silvergrain Classics
feeds.description: SIlvergrain Classics is home to a high-quality analogue photography magazine, workshops and courses, well-equipped studio and darkroom.

feeds.title: The Resurrected Camera
feeds.description: A Film Photography Blog.

feeds.title: Captured by Film
feeds.description: A Film Photography Blog.

feeds.title: Film Still Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am an Engineer with a Photography hobby currently located in Houston Texas after 18 years of globetrotting. Every photographer goes through their own journey and while there are similarities, this art form is broad enough to give us the freedom to meander our way. So this blog is my documentation of my own meandering thoughts and learnings.

feeds.title: Portraits on Film
feeds.description: I live in Minneapolis, Minnesota and have a passion for making portraits using view cameras and large format, black and white film. I have been drawn to older wooden film cameras and formats up to 8×10 inch negatives. And here you can find all and everything I know and do.

feeds.title: Johnny Martyr
feeds.description: Film Photography for the 21st Century

feeds.title: North East Liberties
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michael McNeill. This is a blog about film photography and traditional darkroom printing on silver gelatin paper such as Ilford FB Classic, Ilford Warmtone.

feeds.title: 127 Film
feeds.description: 127 Film is a resource for community, inspiration, and information about 127-format film photography, created and maintained by J. M. Golding.

feeds.title: Going Lomo
feeds.description: Going Lomo is a film photography blog. Find articles on camera, film, effects, and more.

feeds.title: Alex Burke Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alex Burke. I venture deep into the wilderness so I can witness the most vibrant sunrises and sunsets from the best possible location. It is my goal to bring the entire experience of the journey and the majestic scenery to life in my photographs. Using a large-format film camera, I capture Colorado's magnificent beauty.

feeds.title: Bill Smith's Photography
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Bill Smith and on my blog, Fun With Cameras you will find posts about film photography and analogue cameras.

feeds.title: 35 millimetre
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Charlie. Based in Bristol, transplanted from London, I have been taking photos since I could hold a camera and this place is a mix of portfolio and blog, this is where I will be recording and developing my journey in photography. I also make Dinohoodies, explore a low-impact lifestyle, and write for casual photophile.

feeds.title: arhphotographic Blog
feeds.description: ARH Photographic is a source to read about all and everything on film photography.

feeds.title: SHOUT Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Andy and I've been taking pictures since I was about 7. This blog will be mostly filmed (analogue) photography based as that's where my main interest lies, but no doubt the odd bit of digital will creep in here and there, as might the odd post about other things that interest me - campervans, travel, art, wine, and especially cheese and chocolate!

feeds.title: Nick Collingwood Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Nick. I am an NYC based filmmaker and photographer that loves shooting on film and embracing the serendipitous nature of the analogue medium. I aim to create images and films that aren't cheesy or hyper-real but instead are gorgeous one-of-a-kind works, imperfections and all.

feeds.title: Photography & Vintage Film Cameras
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mike. I spend much of my time making photographs, usually with old film cameras. A move to Albuquerque at the beginning of 2008 has given my photo work more of an urban character.

feeds.title: Kosmo Foto
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Stephen Dowling and I blog about the cameras I use. This blog's mission is to dispel some of the myths about the film - that's it's too hard, too technical, too expensive, too confusing. Film still has a place alongside digital photography, and I hope you learn a little about it along the way.

feeds.title: Fogdog Blog
feeds.description: FogDog is a website devoted to film photography and film cameras. I am an amateur photographer, writer, wanderer and dreamer. I enjoy making photographs and tinkering around with old cameras. My camera reviews are just my personal opinion. I've tried lots of different old cameras and perhaps something I write here can be beneficial to you.

feeds.title: Aly's Vintage Camera Alley
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alyssa Chiarello. I started photography when I was 12 years old and now it is a part of me and my pictures are an expression of what I am feeling and going through. I love the lighting, and shadows that express feeling in my photos. All photography is done on film using vintage cameras.

feeds.title: 6×6 Portraits
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kenneth Wajda, I am a photographer who loves old cameras, film photography and storytelling with images.

feeds.title: Camera Go Camera
feeds.description: A camera lover with the heart of a Womble. Peggy Marsh is a teacher who loves film photography, walking, and cycling. Her blog posts cover finding & testing film cameras, thoughts & musings, junk camera finds, and other life stuff.

feeds.title: Shoot It With Film
feeds.description: Shoot It With Film is here to help you share your passion for film photography. Whether you love medium format, instant cameras, or anything in between, you'll find a home here with inspiring and educational content to enjoy. Our goal here is to be a supportive and inclusive place where film photographers can learn, share, and grow.

feeds.title: Analog.Cafe
feeds.description: Analog.Cafe is a group effort from 116 contributing writers, artists, and photographers featuring weekly photo essays on art, travel, culture, analogue cameras, film, history, and techniques.

feeds.title: MrLeica
feeds.description: I'm Matt. I'm a self taught photographer with 10+ years experience of photographing portraits, models and weddings. Blog reviews include a combination of technical detail, example images, and side by side comparisons.

feeds.title: thegashaus
feeds.description: My name is Mark. I am a geographer, transit data analyst, writer, tinkerer, and collector of cameras. The appeal of vintage cameras was first related to their mechanical nature, actual function was secondary. That quickly changed when I started to run film through them, then started to process my own film. This hobby has quickly snowballed to consume a good amount of time each day, but I wouldn't change a thing.

feeds.title: View From The End Of The World
feeds.description: Steve Mitchell grew up in Cambridge, New Zealand, and bought his first camera at the age of eleven. He used a number of different cameras over the years, following the trend to digital imaging in the mid 2000s. He stumbled back into the world of film photography in 2018, realising that the analogue process delivers an experience, and a result that is different, and for him more satisfying than the digital process.

feeds.title: TeGieeR
feeds.description: Welcome to my analogue photography blog. My name is Mike Sikorski TeGieeR. I am a photographer from Gdansk Poland and I shoot on film. On this site, I publish street photography, reportage, fine art photography but also my everyday photos of friends and family. Sometimes I experiment with old cameras and expired films, double expositions, panoramas and cross processing.

feeds.title: Film Shooters Collective Blog
feeds.description: An international collective of film photographers. Providing inspiration, reviews, and photo essays each week on our blog. Our goal is to provide film photographers with opportunity, community, and education.

feeds.title: Emulsive
feeds.description: EMULSIVE is a space for film photographers of all ages and backgrounds to share their knowledge, experience and thoughts about everything related to film photography.

feeds.title: 35hunter Blog
feeds.description: A Film photography Blog By 35hunter.

feeds.title: Peter Jeffrey Blog
feeds.description: The ramblings of a film photographer, his travels, his family, and his passions.

feeds.title: The Photography Professor
feeds.description: Lee Jones created this website to learn more about digital and film-based photography and to provide a resource for his students. It includes guides on film photography, instant photography, digital photography, and darkroom.

feeds.title: Curated Snaps
feeds.description: I'm Liin. Curated Snaps is primarily a place where I document my foray into the wonderful world of analogue photography. I'll also occasionally share some reflections or short stories I've written.

feeds.title: Seeing Wide
feeds.description: My name is Monette. I work night shifts. I drink far too much coffee. On my days off, I like to walk around and take photos. Here on Seeing Wide, you'll find my work and what I'm up to.

feeds.title: KMD Film Photography
feeds.description: My name is Kris and by using traditional film photography methods, I will help you create art from your precious moments. I am a queer artistic photographer who values good contrast in lighting, precious candid moments, beautiful creative details, and kind loving connections. With over 10 years of experience, I offer artistic and creative photography using the traditional yet timeless medium of analogue photography.

feeds.title: ILFORD Photo
feeds.description: ILFORD Photo and guests blog about all things film photography and darkroom related

feeds.title: Chris Chinnock Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Chris Chinnock. I'm a photographer based in Huddersfield West Yorkshire and shooting on film is my thing. I enjoy sharing stories and my experiences from behind the camera via my blog - expect to see camera reviews, guides to shooting, developing and printing photographs from the film as well as behind the scenes on photo shoots and the story behind the images.

feeds.title: A Film Photography Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to film photography, shooting film, expired film, discussions, reviews, cameras, travel, food, all shot on film.

feeds.title: Camera Film Photo Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Vishal and I am the man behind Camera Film Photo. By profession I am a I.T. specialist, but now Camera Film Photo has become my full time job and my objective is to share with you what I love and get more people keeping analogue photography alive. Enjoy the process! Shoot Film!

feeds.title: For the easily distracted Blog
feeds.description: A Film Photography Blog

feeds.title: Film Photography By Laura Ward
feeds.description: A Film Photography Blog by Laura Ward.

feeds.title: Filmosaur | The Ramblings of an Obstinately Old-fashioned Photographer
feeds.description: A Film Photography Blog.

feeds.title: Broken Camera . Club Blog
feeds.description: My year with film and old cameras. Find out photos taken with the camera and my thoughts about each camera.

feeds.title: Tim Dobbs Photography
feeds.description: Tim Dobbs is a Film Photographer based in South Wales, UK. In the blog, Tim talks about different cameras and give his views with a few example photos.

feeds.title: Alex Luyckx Blog
feeds.description: Capturing Beauty in Everything Welcome to Alex Luyckx Photography. I offer a variaty of photographic services throughout Southern Ontario.

feeds.title: Film Based Traveler Blog
feeds.description: I started this blog in 2016 with the goal to travel the world (hopefully full-time) with a film camera. In short, Film Based Traveler is my blog to share my combined interest in travel and photography. Currently, I blog mainly about film photography, the technique I learned, and showcasing film samples at FILM LOOK so readers can grasp its look.

feeds.title: FILTRfilm - 35mm SLR Film Blog
feeds.description: Vintage Film Cameras. Pentax, Canon, Nikon, Zenit, Minolta & more. Retro film cameras ready to use straight away. 35mm Film Cameras sourced by hand.

feeds.title: Learn Film Photography
feeds.description: The Internet is absolutely rife with misinformation. But there are still plenty of trustworthy voices out there with some amazing resources, tools, and techniques. Learn Film Photography is going to bring all the tried, tested, and true methods we've used to create our favourite film results. We're creating tools and advice for eco-conscious film development and printing methods.
